description: One line of the events log (JSON Lines, events-YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl next to the usage log). Events are not requests. Later versions may add properties or kinds; none is ever renamed, removed or retyped.

code.description: A short machine-readable code for what happened, such as changed or rate_limited. May be left out; absent means none.

detail.description: A short note for people, such as where a change came from. Never content, never a secret. May be left out; absent means none.

kind.description: What happened, as a dotted name: config.change, health.change, health.demote, health.restore, alert.fired or alert.resolved. Later releases may add kinds.

subject.description: What it happened to: a setting's key path, a provider, or an alert's scope. A label, never content. May be left out; absent means none.

value.description: A figure or state, as text, when the kind has one. For a setting, only for numbers, flags and modes; never a key, a token, a path or other text. May be left out; absent means none.

title: Maple events record, schema version 1
